project: SQLiGuard - SQL Injection Detection and Prevention Framework
scope: Local, intentionally vulnerable training application only

results.name: Vulnerable endpoint: valid sample account
results.purpose: Confirm normal login works on the baseline.

results.name: Vulnerable endpoint: invalid credentials
results.purpose: Confirm ordinary invalid credentials are rejected.

results.name: Vulnerable endpoint: SQL injection probe
results.purpose: Reproduce the known weakness in the intentionally vulnerable local endpoint.

results.name: Secured endpoint: valid sample account
results.purpose: Confirm the secured implementation preserves legitimate login.

results.name: Secured endpoint: invalid credentials
results.purpose: Confirm the secured implementation rejects invalid credentials.

results.name: Secured endpoint: same SQL injection probe
results.purpose: Verify the same input does not bypass authentication.

results.name: Secured endpoint: empty credentials
results.purpose: Confirm empty fields do not authenticate.

results.name: Secured endpoint: quote-only username
results.purpose: Confirm a quote character is treated as ordinary input.

results.name: Secured endpoint: SQL metacharacters in username
results.purpose: Confirm SQL-like text does not alter the secured query structure.

results.name: Secured endpoint: whitespace-only credentials
results.purpose: Confirm whitespace-only values do not authenticate.

results.name: Source review: SQL uses placeholders and bound parameters
results.input_category: Secure coding control / static source check
results.purpose: Check that the secured PHP query uses placeholders and bind_param rather than interpolating user input.

results.name: Source review: HTML output is escaped
results.input_category: Secure coding control / static source check
results.purpose: Check that the displayed username is passed through htmlspecialchars with quote handling and UTF-8.

results.name: Source review: database errors are not returned to users
results.input_category: Secure coding control / static source check
results.purpose: Check that database errors are logged server-side and the response uses a generic service message.

results.name: Source review: authentication failure message is generic
results.input_category: Secure coding control / static source check
results.purpose: Check that failed logins use a generic message rather than identifying which credential was incorrect.

limitations: This is a small proof of concept for a single local login workflow, not a general-purpose SQL injection scanner.
The suite combines HTTP behavior tests with simple source-pattern checks; source checks are not a complete code audit and can produce false positives or false negatives.
Response-message checks can miss vulnerabilities that do not change the visible login result.
The supplied training database uses demonstration credentials and plaintext sample passwords; do not deploy it publicly or use real accounts.
